summary: perf-load, perf-load-hog and perf-load-hog-macos leave every push to main and run once a day on main as daily-perf-load, daily-perf-load-hog and daily-perf-load-hog-macos in the daily long lanes; the Performance workflow runs only by manual dispatch

compatibility.detail: None of these checks was required; no required check or ruleset change. Main baselines and snapshots now come from the daily-perf-load job (its own conclusion) as well as Performance's earlier main runs. The main_performance_failures GitHub observer field watches perf.yml push runs, which no longer happen.

manual.detail: A red daily load lane appears in the daily report and opens or comments on the one daily tracking issue. Dispatch Performance to measure a branch.
